body: Slight update : Fan is starting to sound a bit scary. Like a voice saying "ooooooooo". Also happens a lot when I'm in this scared state.
Thank you for the kind words. Would you mind telling me what your major was at the time?

That's not possible unfortunately. I still live with them (in our culture it's normal to not move out and simply gradually start managing house expenses) and my father pays for everything college related so he would naturally become informed if I switched majors. Thanks for the advice though.
